title: spec review: Q6: orchestrator/planner_shadow.py + .mcp.planner-shadow.json — non-mutating Opus shadow Planner launches, structured result parsing, agreement scoring (P6)
spec:
Why: the brief (P6) requires shadow mode where Fable stays the production Planner and an Opus shadow decision is recorded without any production effect. goals.launch_planner (goals.py:322-353) and planner_runs.launch_routed give the headless Planner the full MCP surface (.mcp.planner.json: orchestrator, bus, github) and all tools, so a shadow launch through them could mutate the bus, plan.md or git.
What: new module orchestrator/planner_shadow.py and new file .mcp.planner-shadow.json = {"mcpServers": {}}. The prompt template .orchestrator/prompts/planner-shadow.md already exists on the goal branch (placeholder {{packet}}); render it with spawn.render("planner-shadow", packet=...). Do not edit any prompt file.
- eligible(router_decision, cfg, *, sample) -> (bool, reason): True only when router_decision.mode == "shadow", router_decision.shadow_tier is not None, router_decision.hold is False, sample <= cfg["shadow_sample_rate"]; reasons: mode_not_shadow, hard_decision, no_shadow_tier, held, sampled_out.
- argv(prompt, *, model, budget_usd, system_prompt_path) -> list: ["claude", "-p", prompt, "--model", model, "--output-format", "json", "--max-budget-usd", str(budget_usd), "--mcp-config", ".mcp.planner-shadow.json", "--strict-mcp-config", "--disallowedTools", "Edit,Write,MultiEdit,NotebookEdit,Bash,Task,WebFetch,WebSearch", "--append-system-prompt", <text of .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md>, "--dangerously-skip-permissions"]; no bus/orchestrator MCP server, no write tools.
- launch(prompt, *, model, account, budget_usd, log, root=ROOT, popen=None) -> {"pid", "log", "stderr_log", "argv"} or None on any exception (logged to stderr, never raised; the production launch must not be affected). Env: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from account.config_dir, ORCH_ROOT, ORCH_SHADOW=1, oauth token like goals.launch_planner; never resolve [secrets.planner] (a shadow has no GitHub or Jev access). popen defaults to goals.Popen so tests inject a fake. Budget from [limits].max_budget_usd.planner_shadow default 1.5 (caller passes).
- parse(log_path) -> structured dict or None: last JSON line of the log, take its "result" text, spawn.extract_json (orchestrator/spawn.py:646) it, whitelist keys proposed_action (one of fix_round, respec, escalate, noop, synthesize_now, wait_for_more, drop_low_confidence, write_specs, close, other), summary (cap 800 chars, jev.redact applied), tasks_proposed (list of {title (cap 120), scope (list cap 10)} cap 10), confidence (float 0-1 or None), needs_fable (bool), unresolved (list of str cap 10, each cap 200); plus usage fields via bus.normalize_usage("claude", usage), total_cost_usd, session_id, is_error. Anything else dropped; malformed -> {"parse_error": True, usage...}.
- record(*, launch_id, goal_id, decision_type, state_version, model, tier, started_at, parsed, latency_s, root=None) -> schedlog.append("planner_shadow", row) row without prompt text.
- score(shadow_row, production_materiality) -> {"agreement": True|False|None, "basis"}: compare shadow proposed_action to what production did: production materiality (Q2 shape: new_tasks, fix_strategy_for, escalated, plan_changed) maps to fix_round when fix_strategy_for non-empty, write_specs/synthesize_now when new_tasks non-empty and no fix_strategy, escalate when escalated, noop when nothing material; agreement None when production materiality is missing or shadow parse_error. Also record whether shadow needs_fable matched a later production re-escalation (field needs_fable_matched, None when unknown).
- summary(root=None) -> {"n", "agreement_rate", "needs_fable_rate", "parse_error_rate", "usd", "tokens"} tolerant of malformed lines.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_argv_has_no_bus_mcp_and_no_write_tools — argv uses .mcp.planner-shadow.json (whose file content has an empty mcpServers map), --strict-mcp-config, a --disallowedTools list containing Edit, Write and Bash, the shadow model, and never .mcp.planner.json

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_launch_failure_is_isolated_and_production_unchanged — a popen that raises makes launch return None without raising; the bus tasks directory and plan.md hash are identical before and after a successful fake launch; env carries ORCH_SHADOW=1 and no secrets.planner values

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_parse_whitelists_and_caps — a log whose result JSON has proposed_action fix_round, a 3000-char summary, 15 tasks and an extra transcript key parses to summary 800 chars, 10 tasks, no transcript; a non-JSON result gives parse_error True with usage still read

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_score_agreement_against_production_materiality — shadow fix_round vs production fix_strategy_for gives agreement True; shadow escalate vs production new_tasks gives False; missing materiality gives None

tests/test_planner_shadow.py::test_eligible_and_summary — eligible is False with reasons for mode off, hard, hold and sampled_out and True for a shadow decision; summary over three rows including one malformed line reports n 3 style counts without raising
